item.content:encoded:
Microsoft has signed a 1.2 GW capacity agreement with Example Data Centers for an AI data center campus in Busan, the companies said on Monday. The first 200 MW phase is scheduled to reach ready-for-service in 2028, with grid interconnection secured from KEPCO through a new 345 kV substation and liquid cooling for GPU clusters. Financing of $2.1 billion is being arranged with a consortium of Korean lenders, and the operator said rack densities above 100 kW will be supported from day one.

Example Data Centers said the Busan site was chosen for its proximity to the new substation and to subsea cable landings, and that the campus will be built in phases as grid capacity is released. The companies did not disclose the lease term, the price per megawatt or the timing of the phases after the first, and KEPCO has not yet published the interconnection approval for the substation.

item.title: Example Data Centers secures $1.4 billion project financing for Incheon 300 MW campus
item.description: Example Data Centers has closed $1.4 billion of project financing for its 300 MW hyperscale campus in Incheon, with debt from three Korean banks and equity from an infrastructure fund. The campus has a grid connection agreement with the utility and is pre-leased to two hyperscalers for the first 120 MW.

item.title: Liquid cooling retrofit cuts PUE to 1.15 at Example's Seoul campus, operator says
item.description: A direct-to-chip liquid cooling retrofit at Example's Seoul data center cut design PUE from 1.4 to 1.15 across 20 MW of AI inference capacity, the operator said, with CDUs installed per row and rack density raised to 80 kW.

item.title: Photo app adds AI image generator for pet portraits
item.description: A consumer photo app has added an AI image generator that turns pet photos into portraits, the company said, with a chatbot to pick styles.
